blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine government bond yields may only start easing over the next six to 12 months as inflation peaks and the central bank nears the end of its tightening cycle, Manulife Investments Philippines said. In a commentary, Manulife said it expects the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) to remain hawkish in the near term, although the peak of monetary tightness is already within reach.
